caption: A toy car is lifted off a sunlit table, and its shadow stays on the table and grows fainter as the car is raised higher.

sa.check: A toy car sits on a sunlit table.
It is lifted off the table.
Its shadow stays on the table.
The shadow grows fainter as the car is raised higher.
The lift comes first and the shadow separates as the car rises.

pc.expect: The shadow separates from the car as it lifts and remains on the surface, on the side away from the sun.
pc.fail: The shadow rises with the car; or stays attached to the wheels in mid-air; or vanishes the instant the car lifts.

pc.expect: The shadow gets fainter and softer the higher the car is raised.
pc.fail: It gets sharper and darker as the car rises; or stays the same at every height; or flickers.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the car's outline, blurring as it fades.
pc.fail: It is a different shape; or splits; or sharpens into a different object.

pc.expect: The car rises only as the hand lifts it, and the shadow stays down on the table.
pc.fail: The car floats up on its own; or the shadow lifts off the table; or the car sinks into the table.
A second car or shadow appears; or the car vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid; or the hand passes through the car.

pc.expect: The car's colour and the table stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the table changes.

note: The hand lifting is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
